PC: Start resuscitation by addressing the initial steps (Airway-Breathing-Circulation-Disability) from Pediatric Advanced Life Support guidelines
Lower the external ventricular drain to the floor
Order a STAT head CT scan

Provide measures to decrease intracranial hypertension:
Raise the head of the bed
Administer mannitol
3% normal saline bolus
Administer a fluid bolus of normal saline
Hyperventilate the patient with bag-mask ventilation
MK: State the patient has increased intracranial pressure physiology
Recognize that the external ventricular drain is not draining
Recognize that the external ventricular drain is obstructed
SBP: Call for a STAT neurosurgical consultation
